Class GradleDistributionPool

java.lang.Object
dev.copperbench.gradle.GradleDistributionPool
public final class GradleDistributionPool extends Object
Reuses already-downloaded Gradle distributions across workspaces. Gradle itself already shares GRADLE_USER_HOME; this pool also copies a ready install into the hash folder for a different distribution URL (official vs China mirror).
